docs.title: Smart Health Monitoring System
docs.text: A full-stack web application designed to monitor, analyze, and manage personal health metrics using modern software engineering principles and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).

docs.title: Project Purpose
docs.text: This project demonstrates: - Practical OOP implementation - Backend development using Flask - Database integration with PostgreSQL - Testing and deployment best practices

docs.title: Project Details
docs.text:
• Author: Francis Kimani
  • Version: 1.0.0
  • Status: Ongoing

docs.title: System Architecture
docs.text:
The application follows a layered architecture:

  • Presentation Layer (Flask routes & templates)
  • Business Logic Layer (Services & Models)
  • Data Access Layer (ORM & Database)

This structure ensures maintainability and scalability.

docs.title: Conclusion
docs.text:
This project demonstrates strong backend development skills, effective use of OOP principles, and real-world problem-solving.

It provides a solid foundation for scalable health monitoring systems.

docs.title: Database Design
docs.text: The database is designed using PostgreSQL with normalized tables.

docs.title: Core Tables
docs.text:
• Users
  • HealthMetrics
  • Alerts

Each table maintains clear relationships and constraints to ensure data integrity.

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text:
The system handles: - Invalid user input - Database connection errors - Authentication failures

Custom error messages improve user experience and debugging.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• User registration and authentication
  • Health metric tracking (e.g., blood pressure, heart rate)
  • Intelligent alert system
  • Data visualization and analytics
  • Secure database storage
  • Modular and extensible architecture

docs.title: Future Enhancements
docs.text:
• API integration with wearable devices
  • Advanced analytics using AI
  • Mobile application support
  • Role-based access control

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10+
  • PostgreSQL
  • Git

docs.title: Project Overview
docs.text:
The Smart Health Monitoring System enables users to track health data, receive alerts, analyze trends, and gain insights into their overall well-being.

The system is built with a strong focus on modular design, scalability, and clean separation of concerns using Object-Oriented Programming principles.
